card.text: The smaller star of Spica, 3.7 times the Sun's width, orbiting its partner every four days.

introduction.text: Its orbit weighs it at 7.21 solar masses; it is 3.74 solar radii with 20,900 K at its surface.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.
